mapper.select: select a.* from (select cert.*, CASE WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY < DATE(NOW()) then '已过期' WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) then '临近六个月' ELSE '正常' END AS certStage, CASE WHEN cert.COMPANY like '%建科国际%' then 1 WHEN cert.COMPANY like '%建科工程技术%' then 2 ELSE 3 END AS sortIndex from BIZ_ZIZHI_CERTIFICATE cert where cert.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE') a ${ew.customSqlSegment}
